offset_semantics: Physical byte offsets within the NAND chip, independently decoded from partition reg properties; not computed from A/B slot offsets.

sage.source_kind: Qualified OpenWiFi DTS source, independently matched to the existing Sage build source

jaguar.source_kind: Independent read-only partition-reg decode of retained qualified running device trees, separately for XV2-2, XV2-2T1 and XE3-4
jaguar.scope: Direct NAND partition children: rootfs at partition@0; rootfs_1 at partition@3400000 or partition@6000000. No leading reserved NAND prefix in these model-specific captures.
jaguar.privacy: Only geometry is retained here; private capture files, locations, hashes and device identities are excluded. This is not new hardware qualification.
